newsitem.title: CANADA: Barrick Gold says in US$500 mln debt issue.
newsitem.headline: Barrick Gold says in US$500 mln debt issue.

text.p: Barrick Gold Corp said on Tuesday that its subsidiary, Barrick Gold Finance Inc, has signed an agreement for the sale of US$500 million of debentures to a group of underwriters.
The non-convertible, guaranteed debentures will bear annual interest of 7.5 percent and will be issued by Barrick Gold Finance, Barrick said in a statement.
The debentures will mature on May 1, 2007 unless earlier redeemed by Barrick Gold Finance.
Proceeds of the offer will be used to repay existing debt of Barrick Gold Corp under its revolving bank credit facility.
Barrick drew about US$500 million from its US$1 billion credit line to help pay for the US$800 million acquisition of gold prospector Arequipa Resources Ltd last year.
The debenture sale is expected to close on April 25.
Barrick recently announced a US$1 billion unsecured debt security shelf filing which would allow the gold producer to issue securities from time to time, over a two-year period.
The filing received an A3 rating from Moody's Investors Service and an A rating from Standard & Poors.
